name: transaction
docs:
Add a commit entry to the Delta Table. This module provides a unified interface for modifying commit behavior and attributes [`CommitProperties`] provides an unified client interface for all Delta operations. Internally this is used to initialize a [`CommitBuilder`]. For advanced use cases [`CommitBuilder`] can be used which allows finer control over the commit process. The builder can be converted into a future the yield either a [`PreparedCommit`] or a [`FinalizedCommit`]. A [`PreparedCommit`] represents a temporary commit marker written to storage. To convert to a [`FinalizedCommit`] an atomic rename is attempted. If the rename fails then conflict resolution is performed and the atomic rename is tried for the latest version.
